name: Achensee Schifffahrt
kurzbeschreibung: The traditional Achensee Schifffahrt has connected Pertisau, Maurach, and Achenkirch since 1887 with a modern fleet set against majestic mountains.
preis: Grand lake cruise adults approx. €27.00; stage tickets and family fares available
oeffnungszeiten: Daily from May to late October hourly from approx. 09:00 to 17:30; special winter cruises
beschreibung:
Overview

The storied Achensee Schifffahrt has connected the picturesque shores of Tyrol's largest lake across the water since 1887. With the ceremonial maiden voyage of the historic steamboat "St. Josef" in the late 19th century, a glorious era of alpine tourism began that continues to delight locals and travelers today. Today, a modern passenger fleet – led by the flagship "Stadt Innsbruck" and the beloved "MS Tirol" – cruises across the emerald-green mountain waters. Along their scheduled routes, the white ships call at six idyllic landing stages: Pertisau, Seespitz, Maurach, Buchau, car-free Gaisalm, and Scholastika in Achenkirch. Throughout the cruise, passengers enjoy breathtaking alpine panoramas of the Karwendel limestone faces and the sharp ridges of Rofan.

Route & Requirements

The varied cruise offerings include reliable scheduled service as well as popular panoramic scenic cruises. A complete round trip takes about two hours and offers the most relaxing way to take in the full dimension of the nine-kilometer-long lake from the water. All vessels in the modern fleet are designed with accessibility in mind: wide boarding ramps, level panoramic salons, wheelchair-accessible restrooms, and spacious open decks allow travelers with mobility limitations and families with strollers to cruise without worry. Bicycles and leashed dogs are also welcome aboard. Boat trips combine seamlessly with hiking: a favorite outing is the hike from Pertisau along Gaisalmsteig to rustic Gaisalm, followed by a comfortable return journey aboard a scheduled ship.

Visit & Arrival

Vessels operate daily in high season from early May to late October on an hourly schedule. In late autumn and winter, atmospheric advent and New Year's Eve cruises with onboard dining are offered. Tickets for single stages or full tours can be purchased directly at ticket counters by the boat piers. The main hub Pertisau and historic Seespitz pier are major transit points; Seespitz provides direct, level transfer to the historic steam railway Achenseebahn. From Jenbach, passengers reach the piers conveniently via regular VVT bus lines.

Tips

Purchase the convenient "Hop-on/Hop-off" day pass to disembark and re-embark at all six landing stages throughout the day. Relax on the open sun deck with a fresh lake breeze while enjoying homemade apple strudel and refreshments from the onboard restaurant.
